policy: Android project and source files are never published to GitHub; only compiled binaries are, as assets of the Android release. The paths under pending_owner_review were tracked before scripts/check-android-publication.cjs existed. Listing them here records that fact; it does not approve them. Move a path to permitted_shared_files only on the repository owner's explicit decision that it is a shared application file. Any Android-related path in neither list fails the check.
owner_decision: After reviewing the eight shared compatibility paths, the owner requested: Push the things necessary for windows app development to github. These eight shared desktop dependencies are approved for that Windows source handoff; native Android projects, credentials and signing files remain excluded.
